items.text: Margaret Mitchell's Gone with the Wind was published on June 10.
items.question: Who in your family read Gone with the Wind first, and did the copy get passed around the house?
items.source_quote: June 10 – Margaret Mitchell's epic historical romance Gone with the Wind is published.

items.text: At the Summer Olympics in Berlin, Jesse Owens won the 100-meter dash on August 3 and went on to win four gold medals.
items.question: Who told you about Jesse Owens winning at the Olympics, and how did the news reach your town?
items.source_quote: August 3 – 1936 Summer Olympics in Berlin (Nazi Germany): African-American athlete Jesse Owens wins the 100-meter dash. He will be the most successful athlete to compete in these games, winning a total of four gold medals.

items.text: Construction of Hoover Dam was completed on March 1.
items.question: Who in your family first showed you a picture of Hoover Dam, and did anyone you knew ever go to see it?
items.source_quote: March 1 – Construction of Hoover Dam is completed.
